should_trigger: I have trained systematically for 10 years and my back growth stalled for a month — how many sets per muscle per week and how close to failure should I train?
How do I test whether my plateau is a fatigue problem or a stimulus problem, and when should I deload versus add volume?
I finished physical therapy for my knee and have medical clearance — how do I progress isolation to compounds and back to normal volume safely?
should_not_trigger: I have never lifted before — what is a good first full-body routine?
What should I eat for breakfast to lose weight?
expected_behavior: Give experienced-trainee volume and RIR ranges with plateau diagnosis and safety bounds, not beginner programming or medical advice.
